name: 阳再线III之炎龙封印
group_note: 夕阳再现III之炎龙封印 (阿凯工作室, AKAI Studio, 2006). Uses the same Tomud '2060' client-version handshake as the other 夕阳再现 family libs in this session (get_id() rejects any first input other than the literal string '2060' with a 'not a Tomud client' message before proceeding to the real English-id prompt at get_id1()). WASM pass fixed: (1) standard §8.1 check_legal_name() i%2 parity gate/[i..<0] suffix slice (is_chinese() itself was already the correct per-codepoint form) -- fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i], bounds halved 2/10 -> 1/5. (2) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() were missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit -- added to both, alongside this lib's own existing (unusual, partial) previous_object()-based guard in valid_read(), left intact. tell_room()'s exclude arg and securityd.lpc's save_object() extension check were both already correct in this lib, no fix needed. Two dns_master.lpc copies exist (adm/daemons/dns_master.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc); only the network/ copy is referenced by the DNS_MASTER macro (adm/daemons/dns_master.lpc is dead, unreferenced by any macro or literal path) and it's commented out of adm/etc/preload with only find_object()-guarded wizard-command callers -- both left untouched, no §7.52 gutting needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (2060 client-version handshake -> English id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat menu ('0' random -> 'y' accept) -> email -> gender -> enters 铁枪庙), admin permission confirmed via '★ 您目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 8302 .lpc files (8205 written, 64 pre-existing errors, 33 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. One CJK-respacing/broken-escape hit (d/city/sj.lpc, a pre-existing unbalanced-quote typo predating this session's changes causing the formatter's tokenizer to lose sync) -- reverted per AGENTS.md §9's documented blind spot #3, the underlying typo left as-is (not chased down further).
